title: One repeated, one missing
notes: A = 6 4 1 8 4 2 7 3: 1 to 8 with 4 twice and 5 missing. i stays at 0 for five swaps, and 6, 2, 4, 8 and 3 go home in turn; the 1 that arrives last is home too. Later the 4 in A[4] finds a 4 already home: a repeat. 13 comparisons and 5 swaps to place everything, then 8 for the scan, which stops on A[4] = 4, not 5. 26 in all, against 42 for selection sort and a scan.
